message.content:
The closures should go into the **same database that tracks the airspace zones and corridors**—the one we all share. That way, everything stays in sync: if a closure pops up, it updates automatically in the same place where the zones and flight paths are defined.

We don’t want separate systems for closures and zones, because then things could get out of sync. For example, if a closure overlaps with a zone but isn’t in the same database, someone might miss it. Keeping it all together makes it easier to spot conflicts and updates.
